notes.text: The page associates the étale topos B_K to a field K and names its groupoid of points Π_K. It states a canonical antiequivalence with the category of separable algebraic closures. The bars on K, the K subscripts and all three E_{K-bar/K} occurrences were read individually; no group letter or index was supplied from mathematical expectation.

The parenthesis explicitly reconsiders the automorphism-group variance: it suggests using the opposite group and says that closures have the variance of fibre functors, opposite to that of points. The inserted K- before the first automorphismes, cancelled K- before the second, inserted de B_K and cancelled K-bar are preserved with their visible scopes.

The next paragraph states that B_K is recovered from continuous local systems on Π_K, or from discrete sets with a continuous E_{K-bar/K} action. The final clause starts with a field homomorphism K→K′ and ends with a comma at the page boundary; no continuation is supplied.

The compact à forms after fibres and after réconstitue have a small lower body plus a detached upper accent. They explain H’s i.e. and added-colon readings. The source also has a separate accent over the initial e of réconstitue; the written spelling is retained. The capital E of Ensembles is visible and is preserved.

The upper small page mark remains doubtful despite H’s editorial identification of author page 1. The large section number 1 and lower pale folio 2 are distinct annotations. Authorship is not inferred from the darkness or paleness of either folio mark.

The original was viewed once for layout and both prepared top/bottom halves once, line by line. All 21 principal text baselines, including the heading and final fragment, were read; marginal numbers and raised additions are inventoried separately. Eight distinct places were enlarged. Three fuller boundary versions complete s’identifie’s descender, the variance passage’s tall strokes and final fibres descender, and the réconstitue/partir letter bounds. All 11 canonical PNG versions were viewed and retained; no whole image or half was reopened.

The second alg terminal remains an explicit punctuation doubt only. The letters are secure, but the short detached horizontal mark can be an elongated abbreviation point or a hyphen. No reading-change row is counted for adding this uncertainty. Pure macro differences, overline/bar syntax, arrow length, and three dots versus a typographic ellipsis do not constitute separate ink readings.

The independent reading was frozen before comparison; four unequal boxes were adjudicated. The abbreviation p with raised t replaces baseline pt. The high page annotation and cancelled K acquire explicit alternatives or uncertainty without extra witness-error counts. The five field-extension separators were compared locally: near-upright and oblique forms are retained under one slash convention. The extra des at the beginning of the second B06 reading is already present immediately before the first box fragment and is not duplicated.
